text:
Alex (support): FYI we have a customer (acct: acme-corp) reporting a 3x token spike on this month's invoice. Ticket #8541. Attaching ledger vs dashboard screenshots — looks like duplicate requests counted.

Maria (billing): sending invoice alert now... :money_with_wings: billing-bot: Invoice 8541 created for acme-corp (temp id 8923)

Sam (infra): looking at ingress logs — saw a flurry of 502s and 401s around 03:12 UTC, client retried 3x. gateway replayed requests because upstream ack didn't arrive.

Priya (sdk-eng): quick note — our JS SDK currently sets idempotency-key but only for generate endpoints; older SDK versions don't include it for embeddings. Might be missing for this customer.

Maria (billing): dashboard shows ~120k tokens, ledger shows ~360k tokens. That 3x matches your retry count Sam :eyes: 

Sam (infra): logs snippet:
```
[03:12:21] client=10.2.1.5 POST /v1/generate 401 "token expired"
[03:12:22] client=10.2.1.5 POST /v1/generate 502 "upstream reset"
[03:12:23] gateway=replay request_id=abcd-1 -> forwarded
[03:12:23] gateway=replay request_id=abcd-2 -> forwarded
```

Alex (support): customer says they saw 401s then retried from client lib automatically.

Priya (sdk-eng): repro steps I used:
```
# expired token flow
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <expired>" -d '{"input":"x"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# client retries on 401; no idempotency header -> server counts each
for i in 1..3; do curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <new>" -d '{"input":"x"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate; done
```

Sam (infra): short-term mitigation: enable server-side dedupe on gateway for 5s idempotency TTL and reject exact-duplicate bodies with same client-id.

Priya (sdk-eng): long term: SDK patch ready (commit afd3b1) to attach `Idempotency-Key` on all client retries and bump client retry logic to use cached new token before resending.

Jordan (sre): we'll need billing adjustment run: Maria can you prepare a prorated credit for duplicate tokens and flag for audit? Also add alert rule: account token spike >2x baseline within 1h.

Maria (billing): will open refund PR and flag finance. I'll send customer note and CC legal. Charging hold until resolution? yes, apply temporary credit and issue statement.

Alex (support): I've posted repro steps and a minimal script in the ticket. Customer wants ETA on fix and refund.

Priya (sdk-eng): ETA: patch release in next patch window (2h), and we'll cut a hotfix if needed. I'll also add automated unit test and e2e for expired-token retry path.

Sam (infra): I've scheduled a short rolling config change to enable short dedupe on gateway in staging, will roll to prod after smoke. Job k8s link: https://k8s.redwood.internal/job/replay-dedupe-1993

Maria (billing): refund initiated, will confirm once ledger entries are adjusted. :white_check_mark:

Alex (support): thanks everyone — I'll update customer and close loop when refund and SDK patch are live. :thumbsup:
